dedupe_keys.name: use of bagasse ash as a concrete additive for road pavement application

description: Louisiana State University researchers publish TranSET project 18CLSU03 data on sugarcane-bagasse ash in concrete. Zenodo supplies a ZIP free under CC BY 4.0, linked to the university project record. The description covers controlled burning and grinding, partial cement replacement, compressive-strength measurements at twenty-eight and ninety days, electrical resistivity and pavement-lane cost comparisons. These observations can calibrate material-property and lifecycle-cost inputs in road-infrastructure simulations. No related catalogue record explicitly covers this experimental package. Coverage is selected laboratory mixtures and preparation conditions, not field pavement deterioration. Changes in ash composition, curing and replacement proportions can alter performance, and cost estimates do not transfer automatically to another project. Internal table structure and measurement uncertainty remain unverified. No archive was downloaded or claimed material benefit reproduced.
